cohesion_pair_definition.note_no_rescaling: restored_work_of_separation_J_m2, rebond_K_geometry_factor, and K_rebond_max are held FIXED at their Kmax=18 calibrated values across all three Kmax points -- Pi_K = K_rebond_max/Kmax is NOT rescaled to stay constant; it varies naturally (0.060 at 15, 0.050 at 18, 0.0429 at 21), matching the already-frozen minimal-slope-screen predictions.

common_random_numbers_design.pairing_rule: the zero-cohesion and finite-cohesion trajectory at a given (seed, Kmax) share an IDENTICAL per-event-index hazard_threshold_action sequence, verified exactly (not merely statistically) after each pair completes
common_random_numbers_design.hazard_configuration_call: Engine.configure_hazard(mode='exponential', seed=<seed>) called once per trajectory before build_engine/reset_engine_registry, per the existing run_trajectory contract

admission_gate_for_stage_1_and_2_traject.reason: contact exposure (integrated negative-K contact time, complete vs. partial excursion counts) is now treated as an outcome and a potential source of K-dependence under study, not an admissibility criterion -- consistent with the slope-exposure-continuation branch's already-accepted reasoning
admission_gate_for_stage_1_and_2_traject.trajectory_action_path_requirement: ONLY the qualified phase-resolved / certified periodic-orbit action path (arrhenius_fracture.crack_rebonding_kinetics_v10230's phase_resolved_action, recorded via the existing bulk_action_records / any_bulk_action_used / all_bulk_action_qualified instrumentation in run_trajectory) may be admitted -- no uncertified DMD, projective, or Poincare acceleration shortcuts (dmd_poincare_acceleration_enabled must be false and verified false in the reloaded config for every trajectory)
admission_gate_for_stage_1_and_2_traject.horizon_limited_trajectory_semantics: a trajectory that exhausts its event/extension/wall-time budget before reaching the developed target is CENSORED (censored=true), never reported as da/dN=0; a censored trajectory does not satisfy the developed/stationarity gate below and cannot be used for Stage 1 pass/fail or for Section E's second-seed gate

developed_growth_and_stationarity_gate.source: scripts/analyze_v10_2_30_developed_fatigue_growth.py, lines 322-359, as cited verbatim by scripts/analyze_v10_2_30_A_native_plus_8PT_final.py:214 ('The 36/36 n80 base trajectories reached 102.668 um and all pass the unchanged stationarity gate.')

formula.stable_growth_provisional: developed_interval.event_count >= 10 AND (final_extension_m - development_m) >= stability_window_m AND late_to_early_rate_ratio is not None AND 0.5 <= late_to_early_rate_ratio <= 2.0
formula.interval_rate_definition: for events with projected_extension_post_m > start_m and projected_extension_pre_m < stop_m: da = sum(projected_advance_m); dN = sum(cycles_between_events); da_dN = da/dN if dN>0 else None

schema_adaptation_for_crack_rebonding_ev.reason: the source script parses a different run harness's steps_{tag}.csv output; the crack-rebonding trajectories (arrhenius_fracture.crack_rebonding_causal_pilot_v2_v10230.run_trajectory) instead emit an in-memory events list keyed by accepted_length_m / cumulative_extension_m / waiting_time_s_this_event / cumulative_time_s -- the GATE FORMULA AND ITS NUMERICAL CONSTANTS above are reused verbatim; only the field-name mapping below is new, not a new criterion

field_mapping.cycles_between_events: event['waiting_time_s_this_event'] * frequency_Hz  (frequency_Hz=1000.0 fixed, so dN = dt * f exactly; this campaign's run_trajectory records waiting_time_s_this_event, not a native cycle counter, and the waveform is a fixed-frequency sinusoid, so this conversion is exact, not an approximation)

developed_growth_and_stationarity_gate.production_developed_da_dN_definition: developed_interval.da_dN from the formula above, evaluated on an UNCENSORED trajectory whose stable_growth_provisional is true; this is the ONLY primary observable used for delta_m / secants in Section C -- all other windows (all-event, post-first-event, final-half, final-six, eventwise, rolling) are secondary/diagnostic per Section C

windows_final_half_and_final_six.definition_basis: event INDEX windows over the reused ~18-event developed target (distinct from the extension-based developed/stationarity gate above, which is authoritative for pass/fail)
windows_final_half_and_final_six.note: indices assume an 18-event trajectory (events 1..18); if a trajectory's actual accepted-event count differs, the same relative windows (last 9 of 18 → final-half; last 6 of 18 → final-six) are computed against the ACTUAL final event count, recorded explicitly in the analysis output alongside the nominal target, per Section C's requirement to report numerical uncertainty

rate_shift_statistic.sign_convention: negative S_h means finite cohesion (rebonding) is SLOWER than zero cohesion at that Kmax/window (rebonding retards growth); positive S_h means rebonding accelerates growth
rate_shift_statistic.waiting_time_simplification_gate: S_h may be computed via the reciprocal waiting-time simplification (log10(sum(zero waiting times)/sum(finite waiting times))) ONLY after the accepted-length identity (sum(finite.accepted_length_m) == sum(zero.accepted_length_m) over the same window, to numerical tolerance) is explicitly checked and reported for that window; if the identity does not hold, the full length/time ratio form above is used and the simplification is not substituted

classifier_reused_verbatim.note: this function classifies FINITE-WINDOW seed-pair agreement (REBONDING_STEEPENS_LOCAL_RESPONSE / REBONDING_PHASE_EXPOSURE_SENSITIVE / etc.); the DEVELOPED-confirmation terminal classification (Section F) is a SEPARATE, new function operating on delta_m computed from the developed_da_dN window instead of the finite-window S_h -- Section F's five classifications are new because no developed-window analog existed before this campaign, not a replacement of this reused classifier

delta_m_and_secant_definitions.three_point_least_squares_delta_m: sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)**2) over the 3 Kmax points in a window

stage_2_conditional_gate.if_gate_fails: STOP -- do not run seed 1001723; do not retune Kmax, frequency, event target, or cohesive strength; report FINITE_WINDOW_STEEPENING_NOT_PERSISTENT or DEVELOPED_REBONDING_SLOPE_EFFECT_WEAK_OR_UNRESOLVED (or SEED_SENSITIVE if a single-seed internal inconsistency is found) per Section F and return control to the user
stage_2_conditional_gate.if_gate_passes: run the identical six-trajectory matrix for seed 1001723 with NO retuning of any frozen parameter after seeing the seed-1720 results

terminal_classifications_section_f.DEVELOPED_REBONDING_STEEPENING_CONFIRMED: both seeds pass the developed/stationarity gate uncensored, both give developed-window delta_m >= 0.25, and both deltas have the same sign
terminal_classifications_section_f.FINITE_WINDOW_STEEPENING_NOT_PERSISTENT: developed-window response falls below the 0.25 slope gate, or loses the positive sign the prior finite-window result showed
terminal_classifications_section_f.DEVELOPED_REBONDING_SEED_SENSITIVE: the two seeds disagree in sign, or their developed-window delta_m values differ by more than 0.25
terminal_classifications_section_f.DEVELOPED_REBONDING_RATE_OFFSET_LIKE: both seeds show |S_h(21)-S_h(15)| < 0.01 decade in the developed window AND |delta_m| < 0.25 for both seeds
terminal_classifications_section_f.DEVELOPED_REBONDING_SLOPE_EFFECT_WEAK_OR: none of the above patterns is matched (default/fallback)

budgets.note: the previous causal-pilot/minimal-slope-screen/slope-exposure-continuation trajectories targeted a 7-8 event / <=30um budget; this campaign's reused developed/stationarity gate requires ~18 events and >=100um of developed growth, so run_trajectory's per-call override parameters (already supported by its existing signature) are widened here. Only the NUMERIC BUDGET is new -- the underlying run_trajectory mechanics, censor semantics, and action-path certification are completely unchanged.
budgets.rationale_for_max_accepted_events_30_vs_: provides >60% margin above the ~18-event developed target so a trajectory that runs slightly long due to natural stochastic variation in event spacing is not artificially truncated into a false censor; a trajectory that still has not reached the developed/stationarity gate by 30 events or 150um is genuinely horizon-limited and is censored, not truncated early

decomposition_section_d.corrected_conditional_mean_bug: the prior campaign's 'conditional mean' excluded zero-K_rebond events entirely; this campaign reports BOTH the unconditional mean (over all events) and the conditional mean (over nonzero-K_rebond events only) plus the nonzero-event fraction, for every trajectory and every pooled Kmax window

fixed_absolute_shielding_benchmark.S_abs_shape_preserving: S_abs(K) = log10( g_zero(K - K_b) / g_zero(K) ), where g_zero is the zero-cohesion rate as a function of K, K_b is the pooled developed action-weighted K_rebond, and the K-K_b evaluation uses shape-preserving interpolation across the zero-cohesion g_zero(K) points
fixed_absolute_shielding_benchmark.S_abs_local_power_law_fallback: S_abs(K) ~= m_zero(K) * log10(1 - K_b/K), used only if shape-preserving interpolation is not admissible (e.g. too few zero-cohesion Kmax points to interpolate reliably), where m_zero(K) is the local zero-cohesion Paris-slope estimate at K
fixed_absolute_shielding_benchmark.S_occupancy_residual: S_occupancy(K) = S_h(K) - S_abs(K), reported strictly as a diagnostic residual (how much of the observed shift is NOT explained by simple absolute load-shielding), never separately fit as its own power law
fixed_absolute_shielding_benchmark.attribution_rule: steepening/flattening is NOT attributed entirely to reduced bond-formation time (an 'occupancy' story) unless the measured occupancy/action diagnostics (unconditional/conditional K_rebond means, nonzero-event fraction, contact-time) actually support that reading for the Kmax range in question
